items.title: eBay (EBAY) Names Renee Paradise Global General Manager Of Fashion
items.summary: eBay (NasdaqGS: EBAY) has appointed Renee Paradise as global general manager of fashion to lead its worldwide fashion business. The role covers both luxury and non-luxury fashion categories as eBay looks to build out its broader fashion offering. Paradise is expected to work closely with Depop to deepen collaboration and reach more younger, fashion-focused shoppers. items.title: 5 Revealing Analyst Questions From eBay’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: eBay’s second quarter results were met with a negative market reaction despite surpassing Wall Street expectations for both revenue and non-GAAP profit. Management pointed to strong execution in focused categories, such as collectibles and fashion, as well as significant growth in the consumer-to-consumer (C2C) and recommerce segments. CEO Jamie Iannone highlighted that over 70% of gross merchandise volume (GMV) came from these strategic priorities, with each growing more than 20% year-over-year
